contentItem.title: 圆的切线：接触圆而不穿过圆的直线
contentItem.englishTitle: A straight line is said to touch a circle which, meeting the circle and being produced, does not cut the circle.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A straight line is said to touch a circle which, meeting the circle and being produced, does not cut the circle.
据说,直线触摸一个圆圈,横交圆圈,延伸圆圈,但不会切割圆圈。（相关点与线段：A）
